pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Healing, growing with the tier, up to +30%%.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.

Will not count without:$(li)1 of any beds$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)any beds$(li)Jukebox$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#furnishing)any furnishing$(/l)$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#storage)any storage$(/l)$(p)Counts against it:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Bed is beside wall, and light is 1-5 from bed, and storage is within 6 of bed.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Bed: any beds$(li)Wall: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#structural)any structural$(/l)$(li)Light: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)$(li)Storage: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#storage)any storage$(/l)
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: Worth more for standing near the right neighbours - never required, only rewarded:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/hearth)Hearth$(/l), within 12 blocks
pages.title: Rooms that go together

pages.text: And rooms that do not go with it - each one costs this room while it stands there:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/ossuary)Ossuary$(/l), sharing a wall$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/stable)Stable$(/l), sharing a wall
